children: Sri Lankan shares closed lower on Monday, dragged down by IT stocks.
were the top percentage losers on the index, down 10.1% and 9.3%, respectively, on the day.
* Trading volume on the index more than doubled to 67.6 million shares from 29.9 million shares in the previous session.
* The equity market's turnover jumped to 3.16 billion Sri Lankan rupees ($9.56 million) from 873.4 million rupees in the previous session, according to exchange data.
* Foreign investors were net sellers, offloading stocks worth 145 million rupees, while domestic investors were net buyers, purchasing shares worth 3.13 billion rupees, the data showed.
